name: ARR-SUM
spec: Return the sum of all elements of the array.

name: ARR-MAX
spec: Return the maximum element of the array (length >= 1).

name: ARR-MIN
spec: Return the minimum element of the array (length >= 1).

name: ARGMAX
spec: Return the index of the maximum element; on ties return the smallest index.

name: COUNT-EVEN
spec: Return how many elements of the array are even (0 counts as even).

name: REVERSE
spec: Reverse the array in place (or return the reversed array).

name: PREFIXSUM
spec: Replace each element with the running sum of all elements up to and including it.

name: SQ-EACH
spec: Replace each element with its square.

name: NEGATE-EACH
spec: Replace each element with its negation.

name: RUNMAX
spec: Replace each element with the maximum of all elements from the start up to and including it.
